blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport in Rio de Janeiro for your international flight.

On the way, you’ll see the familiar hills and coastal neighbourhoods again. This is the final leg of a 12-day itinerary that takes you through Rio, Carnival and Iguazu Falls before a beach stay.

You return to the city where the trip began, with a different view of Rio after visiting several regions. You’ve seen the Sambadrome at night and Rio from its viewpoints by day, taken in the full sweep of Iguazu Falls and seen the cascades up close from the Argentine walkways, then spent several days among the islands of Angra. Those changes of scene shape the route.
